description: List the services of a project (web, APIs, workers, CLI) named by its issues, the default service first. Call it when the user names an app, API or worker that is not a project, or a transaction that tideways_search_traces does not find in the default service, with "search" set to one word of it: each service is searched for that word and the services are sorted by matching traces, so the first ones serve it. Costs 4 requests, plus 1 per service searched: at most 30, fewer when the hourly rate limit is small or nearly used up. Only services named by the newest open or ignored issues are listed; the Tideways UI service selector lists all.

environment.description: Environment, e.g. "production" or "staging". Defaults to the configured environment, else production; "environment" in the result shows which was used. When results come back, an unknown name fails with an error.

project.description: Tideways project as "project" or "organization/project". Defaults to the defaultProject that tideways_list_projects reports; call it for valid names.

search.description: One whole word of the app, API, worker or transaction to find (e.g. "voucher"). Searches the traces of each service for it (one request per service: at most 30 services, fewer when the hourly rate limit is small or nearly used up) and sorts the services by matching traces.

name: tideways_list_services

defaultService.description: The project's default service, read when no service is passed or configured

notSearched.description: Services left out: one call searches at most 30 services, stays within a tenth of the hourly rate limit and keeps 10 requests in reserve; search them with tideways_search_traces

services.description: Services named by the newest open or ignored errors, slow SQL queries and deprecations of all services (first page of each), plus the default service; other services are missing, and the Tideways UI service selector lists all. Sorted default first, then by issues; with "search", by matchingTraces.

issues.description: How many of the issues this call read (open and ignored) name this service

matchingTraces.description: With "search": traces matching the word, up to 30 (30 means at least 30); null when the service was not searched or its search failed

name.description: Pass as "service". A ":cli" suffix marks the CLI scripts and workers of the service named before it.

searchError.description: With "search": why searching this service failed

title: List services
